author: Dr H Morgan, GP
body: Referring Ethan Brookes (DOB 22/05/2018, NHS 9874123003) for paediatric diabetes review. Presented with 3 week history of polyuria and weight loss. Random glucose 22 mmol/L, ketones 4.1, pH 7.32 (no acidosis). New diagnosis of Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus made on 11/06/2026 at Bristol Children's Hospital ED. Enrolled in the TEPLI-TRIAL immunotherapy programme; first teplizumab infusion 26/06/2026. Please arrange MDT review.

author: Dr S Bardsley, Clinical Genetics
body: Owen Williams (DOB 17/12/2012) has been reviewed in the regional genetics clinic. Following persistent fasting hyperglycaemia and a strong paternal family history, HNF1A mutation has been confirmed - diagnosis of MODY3 (HNF1A-MODY). Management with diet alone for now; sulphonylurea may be considered if HbA1c rises.

author: Diabetes MDT
body: Imani Joseph (DOB 07/06/2013, of Black Caribbean ethnicity) newly diagnosed with Type 1 diabetes 04/05/2023. Background of ADHD (diagnosed 2022, on methylphenidate). Mother reports significant difficulty with self-management. Will need close psychology input.

author: Sister J Adamson
body: Jacob Whitfield registered with Northway PDU following discharge from Birmingham Children's Hospital after DKA presentation. ADHD diagnosis recorded; methylphenidate prescribed. Family lives in BB band 2 area. Father is HGV driver, mother is administrator. Confident parents.

author: Diabetes Nurse Specialist K Murray
body: Aisha Khan turning 18 in July 2025 - transition pathway initiated. Joint appointment with adult diabetes team completed today (15/12/2026). Patient happy to transition. Insulin pump (Tandem t:slim X2) to be continued. Final paediatric visit scheduled for 12/01/2027 after which care transfers to adult diabetes service.

author: Dr A Iqbal
body: Sumaiya Begum diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus following raised HbA1c (74) and BMI 33.4 at school nurse review. BMI z-score 2.8. Strong family history (both parents have T2DM). Ethnic background recorded as Bangladeshi. Education on dietary modification and metformin commenced.
